Rect.frozenNote: Win32 ABI, windef.h. Four LONGs, in this order, and the guest binary already contains the compiled instructions that read them at these offsets. Moving one is not a refactor: it is a wire-format change, it traps nowhere, and it misreads every app at once. tools/gen-layout-offsets.js --check refuses any movement.

Point.frozenNote: Win32 ABI, windef.h. Two LONGs, x then y, and the guest binary already contains the compiled instructions that read them at these offsets. Moving one is a wire-format change: it traps nowhere and misreads every app at once. tools/gen-layout-offsets.js --check refuses any movement.
